entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4084474835781915392: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 95168: distance 38.926 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.007), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 38.926 +/- 0.272 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 25.0011 +/- 0.2449 mas (same row, RUWE 2.74), 102.1 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -26.658, 21.579 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 4084474835781915392 (quality E), from 1953GCRV..C......0W; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 3.253 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 95168: radius 3.253 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 30.207 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.044) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 7508 +/- 180 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 95168: effective temperature 7508 +/- 180 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.029).
